title: Build a Claude-based support triage agent for our SaaS helpdesk
description:
We run a B2B SaaS product with about 1,200 support tickets a month in Zendesk. We want an AI agent that reads each new ticket, classifies it (billing, bug, how-to, feature request), drafts a first reply from our help-center articles, and routes it to the right queue. Humans approve every reply for the first month.

We prefer Anthropic Claude. Our stack is Python and AWS (ECS, RDS). We need it deployed in our AWS account with logging and a way to measure answer quality before we widen the rollout.

Please describe a similar agent you have shipped and how you would evaluate the reply quality.
